name: set_uplink
description: Point a Logic Rocket Uplink at a Logic Rocket Downlink (1.14.0+), as screwdriver presses on the uplink's first button do: the uplink then reads the downlink's data network (its rocket's devices). Only a downlink a press could select is taken: built and logic readable (describe_device on the uplink lists them in uplink.choices); anything else is refused invalid_downlink. The host sends the change to clients. Returns uplink, previous_downlink (pass its reference_id to set it back; null when it followed none) and link (the uplink's link now, as describe_device's uplink). Refused: not_uplink (reference_id is not a Logic Rocket Uplink), invalid_downlink, not_host (a multiplayer client), device_not_found. Writes.

downlink_id.description: The Logic Rocket Downlink to follow, from describe_device's uplink.choices.
